title: A low-cost colorimetric sensor for lead detection
abstract: We report a portable colorimetric assay with a limit of detection of 0.8 ug/L.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.label: sec:intro
sections.text: Lead contamination remains a public health problem & requires field-ready tools (see Section~\ref{sec:method}).

sections.heading: Method
sections.label: sec:method
sections.text: Samples were filtered and passed through a chelating membrane.
